description.zh: 24 幅原创女巫与炼金插画：铜与黄铜器皿、烟色玻璃、紫晶与翡翠药液、羊皮纸、皮革、植物和使魔。每幅重新绘制主体构造、材质反光与接触阴影；精细轮廓和局部装饰使用 currentColor，材质与阴影使用固定色。透明背景，无底板，80×80 viewBox；独立内嵌轻微动画，支持宿主暂停和减少动态效果。
description.en: 24 original illustrations of botanical witchcraft and alchemy: copper and brass, smoky glass, amethyst and emerald liquids, parchment, leather, plants and familiars. Redrawn construction, material highlights and contact shadows; currentColor contours and selected accents over fixed material colors. Transparent backgrounds, 80×80 viewBoxes, self-contained subtle animation with inherited pause and reduced-motion support.

lab.zh: 炼金实验室与女巫器物

description.zh: 铜箍三足铸铁坩埚，内盛翡翠绿药液；厚实锅沿、铆钉、木搅拌杆与交叉劈柴具有独立材质，火焰和蒸汽轻动。固定材质色，轮廓随 currentColor。
description.en: Riveted copper and cast-iron cauldron with an emerald brew, substantial rim, wooden stirrer and crossed logs. Flame and steam move gently; fixed material colors with currentColor contours.

description.zh: 铜制穹顶蒸馏头连通长导管，烟色玻璃蒸馏瓶置于铁架和酒精灯上，冷凝液滴落琥珀色接收瓶。固定铜、玻璃与药液色，轮廓随 currentColor。
description.en: Copper alembic head and descending beak above a smoky glass flask, iron tripod and spirit lamp. A subtle moving condensate drop reaches an amber receiver. Fixed materials with currentColor contours.

description.zh: 厚壁灰绿石研钵带铜饰底座，内盛鲜叶和捣碎的草药，石杵在钵沿之后轻轻摆动；叶片、散落种子与刻饰各有清楚层次。固定材质色，轮廓随 currentColor。
description.en: Thick green-gray stone mortar with a copper foot, crushed herbs and a gently moving pestle behind its rim. Layered fresh leaves, seeds and carved detail; fixed materials with currentColor contours.

description.zh: 三种轮廓的烟色玻璃药瓶，分别盛翡翠、紫晶与琥珀色药液。软木与火漆、玻璃球塞、植物标签和月牙铜牌均重新绘制，药液气泡轻浮。固定材质色，轮廓随 currentColor。
description.en: Three smoky glass vessels with emerald, amethyst and amber liquids. Waxed cork, glass stopper, botanical label and crescent tag are carefully constructed; bubbles drift gently. Fixed materials, currentColor contours.

description.zh: 皮面魔法书展开弯曲的羊皮纸书页，书芯、书脊与铜包角清晰分层。左页为草药图版，右页为精细几何星图，红丝带垂落，月星轻浮；不含伪文字。固定材质色，轮廓随 currentColor。
description.en: Open leather grimoire with curved parchment, layered signatures, spine and brass corners. A botanical plate and precise star diagram replace pseudo-text; a red bookmark hangs below gently floating lunar ornaments. Fixed materials, currentColor contours.

description.zh: 烟色水晶球内有紫雾与月星，玻璃的窗形反光和边缘反射强化球体。黄铜弧形托架承重于车削木座，紫雾轻微明暗变化。固定材质色，轮廓随 currentColor。
description.en: Smoky crystal sphere with amethyst mist and lunar emblems, shaped window highlights and rim reflections. Curved brass supports rest on a turned wooden plinth; the inner mist subtly pulses. Fixed materials with currentColor contours.

description.zh: 黄铜提灯以铆接灯沿、拱形通风口、细框玻璃和模制底座构成。烛火在玻璃内轻闪，蜡滴与金属反光清晰，光色限制在灯体内。固定材质色，轮廓随 currentColor。
description.en: Brass lantern with riveted rails, arched vents, framed glass and a molded foot. A gently flickering candle illuminates wax and metal within the lantern; no exterior backdrop. Fixed materials with currentColor contours.

description.zh: 有节疤的弯曲梣木柄连接分束桦枝，铜色绳缠绕束口，枝梢自然展开，带一小段新叶。扫帚轻轻摆动，线条沿真实枝条走向绘制。固定木、铜与叶色，轮廓随 currentColor。
description.en: Curved knotted ash handle, individually shaped birch switches, a copper-toned binding and a small leafy offshoot. The broom gently sways; grain follows the construction. Fixed wood, metal and leaf colors with currentColor contours.

description.zh: 紫灰毡帽的折弯帽尖与宽帽檐重新塑形，皮革帽带、缝补片和方形铜扣贴合帽身，羽毛插在帽带后。帽子轻摆，星形吊坠保留。固定毡、皮革与黄铜色，轮廓随 currentColor。
description.en: Folded plum-gray felt hat with a shaped brim, fitted leather band, stitched patch, brass buckle and tucked feather. A tiny star hangs from the tip as the hat sways. Fixed felt, leather and brass colors with currentColor contours.

description.zh: 黄铜刻度月相轮围绕有月海与环形山的中央月盘，八个月相缓慢公转。明暗月面与刻度具有独立材质，不使用大面积底板。固定金属和月面色，外轮廓随 currentColor。
description.en: Engraved brass lunar wheel around a central relief of maria and craters. Eight distinctly shaded moon phases orbit very slowly, with open space between the metal rings. Fixed metal and lunar colors, currentColor contours.

description.zh: 开放式黄铜星环以交错星带、细刻双环与五颗翡翠铆座构成，中央紫晶轻微闪动。月、星、水滴与三角饰纹保持原创民俗几何，不使用伪符文字。固定材质色，外轮廓随 currentColor。
description.en: Open brass star lattice with crossing relief, engraved double rings, five emerald settings and a subtly pulsing central amethyst. Original folkloric lunar and elemental geometry without pseudo-writing. Fixed materials with currentColor contours.

description.zh: 铜制刻度外环包围缓慢旋转的七芒星与相交三角，紫晶节点和中央月珠组成精密护符。装饰采用可读的几何刻线而非伪文字，环间透明。固定金属与宝石色，轮廓随 currentColor。
description.en: Copper engraved outer ring around a slowly rotating heptagram and interlocking triangles. Amethyst nodes and a central lunar medallion form a precise openwork talisman with geometric engraving. Fixed metals and jewels, currentColor contours.

description.zh: 胡桃木车削立柱与黄铜托板围住双泡玻璃，金沙从上锥细流落向下方沙丘。玻璃高光、连接环与底部阴影独立绘制，整体仅轻微摆动。固定材质色，轮廓随 currentColor。
description.en: Turned walnut posts and brass plates around twin glass bulbs. Golden sand falls in a fine stream onto a lower mound, with glass highlights and detailed joints. The frame sways subtly; fixed materials with currentColor contours.

description.zh: 月牙黄铜天平的立柱、枢轴与阶梯底座稳定承重，链条准确连接两只浅盘。一侧紫晶、一侧羽毛，横梁轻轻摇摆，太阳浮雕点缀立柱。固定材质色，轮廓随 currentColor。
description.en: Crescent-topped brass balance with a stable column, pivot and stepped foot. Suspended chains connect both lips of each pan; crystals and a feather balance on the gently swaying beam. Fixed materials with currentColor contours.

description.zh: 酒红火漆以不规则浇蜡边缘、下凹圆章和月星植物浮雕构成，压在两条紫灰燕尾丝带上。局部高光与固定深色凹槽区分蜡的厚度，印章轻动。固定材质色，轮廓随 currentColor。
description.en: Burgundy poured wax with an irregular rim, recessed medallion and readable lunar botanical relief over two notched ribbons. Fixed dark recesses and warm highlights describe its thickness; a subtle lift preserves the original motion.

description.zh: 渡鸦以厚喙、喉蓑羽、层叠收翼与楔形尾重塑侧影，鳞状足趾牢扣虬枝。深蓝灰羽毛带克制的青绿反光，金眼与新月点明主题，身体轻摆。固定羽、木与月色，轮廓随 currentColor。
description.en: Raven with a heavy hooked bill, throat hackles, layered folded primaries and wedge tail. Scaled toes grip a gnarled branch; slate plumage carries restrained teal reflections beneath a crescent. Subtle sway, fixed materials, currentColor contours.

description.zh: 四分之三坐姿黑猫具有明确后胯、前腿和绕爪尾巴，细长竖瞳、耳内绒毛、口鼻和胡须遵循猫的结构。皮革项圈悬挂铜月牙，身体轻微摆动。固定蓝灰毛色与金色眼睛，轮廓随 currentColor。
description.en: Three-quarter seated black cat with a shaped haunch, distinct forelegs and a tapering tail wrapped around its paws. Slit pupils, soft ears, muzzle and whiskers follow feline anatomy; a brass crescent hangs from a leather collar. Subtle sway, fixed colors, currentColor contours.

description.zh: 蹲伏蟾蜍有横瞳金眼、耳后腺、浅色咽腹、张开的四指前足和折叠后腿。少量按解剖位置安排的疣粒带独立受光，青苔石承托身体，呼吸般轻动。固定绿、石与金色，轮廓随 currentColor。
description.en: Squatting toad with horizontal golden pupils, parotoid glands, pale throat, splayed foretoes and folded hind legs. Selectively placed warts catch light above a mossy stone; a restrained breathing-like lift preserves the original motion. Fixed colors, currentColor contours.

description.zh: 褐色猫头鹰以双面盘、眉羽、细钩喙、层叠飞羽与尾羽重绘，足爪紧扣树枝。胸部羽斑按羽片安排，金色双眼只有轻微光泽变化。固定羽、木、月与金色，轮廓随 currentColor。
description.en: Tawny owl with structured facial discs, brow feathers, a small hooked bill, overlapping primaries and a shaped tail. Talons grip the branch; chest markings follow the plumage and golden eyes gently glint. Fixed colors, currentColor contours.

description.zh: 曼德拉草以真实分叉主根和细须根组成民俗小人，浅刻面孔隐藏在根部褶纹中。顶端叶丛具有脉络与卷曲方向，琥珀浆果伸出叶间，根体轻跳。固定植物、土根与浆果色，轮廓随 currentColor。
description.en: Folkloric mandrake formed from branching taproots and fine rootlets, with a small face in the root folds. Veined leaves and amber berries rise from the crown; a restrained lift keeps the original animation. Fixed botanical colors, currentColor contours.

description.zh: 颠茄以交互生长的卵形脉纹叶、下垂紫色五裂钟花和带宿存花萼的亮黑浆果绘成植物图版。枝干弧度和花柄真实连接，花朵轻摆。固定叶、花与浆果色，细轮廓随 currentColor。
description.en: Botanical belladonna with alternate veined ovate leaves, pendant five-lobed violet bells and glossy dark berries in persistent calyces. Connected stems and flower stalks curve naturally; the flowers sway lightly. Fixed botanical colors, currentColor contours.

description.zh: 树枝悬挂的圆蛛网由不等长放射丝、自然下垂的螺旋丝和少量断口构成，露珠在丝结处聚集。中心圆蛛与垂丝小蛛具八足，网面轻摆。固定树枝与露珠色，细网线随 currentColor。
description.en: Orb web suspended from a twig, with unequal radial anchors, sagging spiral silk and a few natural gaps. Dew collects at junctions; an eight-legged orb-weaver and hanging spider complete the gently swaying web. Fixed twig and dew colors, currentColor silk.

description.zh: 烟色药瓶盛有紫晶药液，瓶口铜圈、颈部绳结与月牙标签层次明确，拔出的软木塞停在一旁。三股有留白的紫雾与小气泡轻浮，玻璃反光保持克制。固定材质色，轮廓随 currentColor。
description.en: Smoky amethyst potion vial with a brass mouth, tied neck and crescent label; the removed cork sits beside it. Three open curls of vapor and small bubbles rise gently, with restrained glass reflections. Fixed material colors, currentColor contours.

description.zh: 深蓝灰月盘遮住太阳，外沿仅保留黄铜色日缘、细长火焰状日冕、贝利珠与钻石环闪光。刻度环镂空，日冕缓慢变亮变暗，不铺设光晕背景。固定天体与金色，细外环随 currentColor。
description.en: A dark slate lunar disc occludes the sun, leaving a golden limb, tapered coronal filaments, Baily’s beads and a diamond-ring glint. The engraved outer ring remains open; the corona pulses gently without a background glow. Fixed celestial colors, currentColor accents.
